# Catch, Landings, and Discards {.unnumbered}

AGEPRO calculates catch at age for each fleet using the Baranov catch equation [@quinnii1999]. Catch represents the portion of the population vulnerable to harvest as determined by selectivity and mortality at age. The catch of age-$a$ fish by fleet $v$ in year $t$ is

$$ 
C_{a,v}(t)= \frac{F_{a,v}(t)}{M_a(t)+F_{a,v}(t)}{\Bigl[ 1-e^{-M_a(t)-F_{a,v}(t)}\Bigr]} \cdot N_a(t) \tag{6}\label{eq:6}
$$ 

To account for discards, let $d_{a,v}(t)$ be the proportion of age-$a$ fish discarded by fleet $v$ in year $t$; $w_{L,a,v}(t)$ and  $w_{D,a,v}(t)$ are the mean landed and discarded weights at age. Then the total landed and discarded weights by fleet $v$ in year $t$ are

$$
L_v(t)=\sum\nolimits_{a=1}^{A} {\Bigl[ 1 - d_{a,v}(t) \Bigr]} \cdot C_{a,v}(t) \cdot w_{L,a,v}(t) 
\tag{7}\label{eq:7}
$$ 


$$
D_v(t) = \sum\nolimits_{a=1}^{A}d_{a,v}(t) \cdot C_{a,v}(t) \cdot w_{D,a,v}(t) 
\tag{8}\label{eq:8}
$$
